note: Rules apply in declaration order per file. Long, line-specific rules are declared before the uniform ones they would otherwise be consumed by. A rule that matches nothing fails the run, so upstream drift surfaces as a STALE RULE instead of a silent loss.

Rewritten for Pi. Upstream 0.15.2 weakened the opening non-negotiable to a citation rule and dropped the instruction to make reading the Principles the first todo, which its own guide diagram still shows. This file keeps that instruction, names Pi agents and tools, and points at the skills this package ships rather than cursor-team-kit. Upstream edits must be merged by hand, which the baselined hash enforces.
Upstream writes a Cursor always-applied rule. Pi writes the native subagents.* keys instead, so the headless path and the /pstack-setup picker share one source of truth.
Pi installs a package and reloads, where Cursor installs a plugin from a marketplace. The whole page is the install and setup walkthrough.
